verdicts.why: Systeme.io is the better default for most course creators starting out — 0% fees, a free plan, and paid tiers that cost far less than Kajabi's $179 floor — though Kajabi is worth the jump once you need uncapped funnels and its built-in AI from day one.
A freelancer selling a handful of digital products or a single course gets everything needed on Systeme.io's free plan or its $17/mo Startup tier, well under Kajabi's $179/mo floor.

Systeme.io fits an agency managing several client funnels or course sites better, since every plan includes unlimited white-label sub-accounts at no extra cost, and Kajabi has no equivalent multi-client reseller feature.

Neither is built for a real inventory-and-shipping business: Systeme.io caps physical-product variants at 50 to 5,000 depending on plan, and Kajabi's plan limits list only digital products, so a store selling physical goods needs a dedicated ecommerce platform instead.

Neither fits a local service business's daily work: both are built around selling courses, funnels and digital content, not appointment booking, invoicing or field-service scheduling for a plumber, salon or contractor.
Neither fits a software company either: both are course-and-funnel platforms, not the recurring-billing and API infrastructure a SaaS product needs to run its own subscriptions.
